region.name: Maharashtra
region.tagline: Forts, caves and a coastline that never sleeps.
region.overview: Maharashtra is a state of contrasts. Mumbai's skyline and colonial landmarks sit beside the quiet Sahyadri forts, ancient Buddhist caves and Maratha history. Travellers can pray at Jyotirlingas, trek monsoon-green hills, and eat their way from vada pav to Kolhapuri misal.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide photo showing Maharashtra's mix of coast and fort-topped hills

live_updates.title: Ganesh Chaturthi
live_updates.description: Mumbai and Pune light up with huge community Ganesh pandals, processions and immersions.

live_updates.title: Navratri and Dussehra
live_updates.description: Garba, Ramlila and temple festivals mark the nine nights and the Dussehra celebrations in October.

live_updates.title: Diwali
live_updates.description: Cities fill with lanterns, lights and sweets as Diwali approaches in early November.

live_updates.title: Sewri flamingo season
live_updates.description: Flamingos gather on the Sewri mudflats through winter.

live_updates.title: Monsoon fort treks
live_updates.description: Sahyadri forts and waterfalls turn green; trekking around Pune and Lonavala peaks.

live_updates.title: Pandharpur Kartiki Ekadashi yatra
live_updates.description: Pilgrims walk to Pandharpur for the Kartiki Ekadashi celebrations.

live_updates.title: Kala Ghoda Arts Festival
live_updates.description: Mumbai's arts festival fills Kala Ghoda with exhibitions and performances, usually in early year.

cities.name: Mumbai
cities.tagline: City of dreams, sea and street food.
cities.blurb: India's fast, busy coastal city, with grand colonial buildings, sea-facing walks and forgotten forts waiting just off the main roads.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide photo that captures the spirit of Mumbai

cities.name: Pune
cities.blurb: A cultural hub with Peshwa-era landmarks, museums and a ring of forts and caves within easy reach.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide photo that captures the spirit of Pune

cities.name: Nashik
cities.blurb: A holy city on the Godavari that also hosts a growing wine scene and ancient caves.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide photo that captures the spirit of Nashik

cities.name: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar
cities.blurb: A city of historic gates and tombs, and the base for two of India's great cave complexes.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide photo that captures the spirit of Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

cities.name: Nagpur
cities.tagline: Orange city at the heart of India.
cities.blurb: A central Indian city known for its oranges, Deekshabhoomi and nearby forests.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide photo that captures the spirit of Nagpur

cities.name: Kolhapur
cities.tagline: Royal city of spicy food and wrestling.
cities.blurb: A palace town with a powerful Devi temple, a spicy food culture and old Maratha forts in the hills.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide photo that captures the spirit of Kolhapur

attractions.name: Gateway of India
attractions.summary: Mumbai's seafront arch, where the city first meets the sea.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Gateway of India, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A grand basalt arch on the Colaba waterfront, facing the Arabian Sea. It was built to mark the 1911 visit of King George V and Queen Mary and later became the symbol of Mumbai. Boats to Elephanta Island leave from the jetty right beside it.
important_facts: Built in the Indo-Saracenic style using yellow basalt
Completed in 1924
Ferries to Elephanta Caves depart from the nearby jetty
fascinating_facts: The arch was built to welcome a royal visit in 1911, yet the last British troops left India through it in 1948.
detail_page.local_tip: Come at sunrise for calm views; evenings get very crowded.

attractions.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT)
attractions.summary: A railway station that looks like a Gothic cathedral.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Formerly Victoria Terminus, this working railway station mixes Victorian Gothic with Indian palace styles. Carved stone, domes and turrets make it one of the most photographed buildings in Mumbai.
important_facts: Designed by architect F. W. Stevens
Declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2004
Completed in 1888
detail_page.local_tip: Photograph the facade from across the road in the evening when it is lit up.

attractions.name: Elephanta Caves
attractions.summary: Rock-cut Shiva caves on an island in Mumbai harbour.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Elephanta Caves, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A short boat ride from Mumbai takes you to Gharapuri island, where ancient rock-cut caves hold powerful sculptures of Shiva. The giant three-faced Maheshamurti is the highlight.
important_facts: Declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1987
The main cave holds the Maheshamurti, a huge three-faced Shiva
Reached by ferry from the Gateway of India area
detail_page.local_tip: Carry water and snacks; options on the island are limited.

attractions.name: Marine Drive
attractions.summary: Mumbai's curved sea-front promenade, loved at sunset.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Marine Drive, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A long curve of road and sea wall along the Arabian Sea. When lit at night, the street lights look like a necklace, which is why it is called the Queen's Necklace. Locals come here to walk, sit on the wall and watch the sunset.
important_facts: Called the Queen's Necklace for its night-time lights
Lined with Art Deco buildings
detail_page.local_tip: Walk from Nariman Point towards Girgaum Chowpatty at dusk.

attractions.name: Siddhivinayak Temple
attractions.summary: One of Mumbai's most visited Ganesha temples.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Siddhivinayak Temple, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A busy and beloved Ganesha temple in Prabhadevi. Devotees from across the city queue here, especially on Tuesdays and during Ganesh Chaturthi.
detail_page.local_tip: Weekdays other than Tuesday are usually calmer.

attractions.name: Haji Ali Dargah
attractions.summary: A white mosque and tomb out in the sea, reached by a walkway.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Haji Ali Dargah, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: The dargah of Pir Haji Ali Shah Bukhari sits on an islet off Worli, joined to the shore by a narrow causeway. At high tide the path goes under water, so timing matters.
important_facts: Stands on an islet linked by a causeway to the shore
The causeway is cut off at high tide
detail_page.local_tip: Check the tide before you go, as the causeway can be closed at high tide.

attractions.name: Sanjay Gandhi National Park
attractions.summary: A forest with leopards inside the city limits.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Sanjay Gandhi National Park, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A large green patch in northern Mumbai with forest trails, lakes and wildlife. It is also home to the Kanheri Caves, an ancient Buddhist site.
important_facts: Home to the Kanheri Caves
Leopards are found in and around the park
detail_page.local_tip: Wear sturdy shoes; trails are long and uneven.

attractions.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya
attractions.summary: Mumbai's grand museum, in a landmark Indo-Saracenic building.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Formerly the Prince of Wales Museum, this museum in Kala Ghoda holds art, sculpture and historical objects inside a striking domed building with a garden.
detail_page.local_tip: Pair it with a walk through nearby Kala Ghoda's galleries and cafes.

attractions.name: Juhu Beach
attractions.summary: A busy city beach with street food and sunsets.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Juhu Beach, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: One of Mumbai's best-known beaches, popular for evening walks, sunsets and chaat and pav bhaji stalls.
detail_page.local_tip: Visit for the food and the people-watching; swimming is not recommended.

attractions.name: Banganga Tank
attractions.summary: A quiet ancient water tank hidden among Malabar Hill's tall buildings.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Banganga Tank, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Stone steps, small temples and old houses surround this tank near Walkeshwar Temple. It feels like a small village in the middle of the city, and locals still come to bathe and pray.
fascinating_facts: Locals link the tank to a legend about Lord Ram, who is said to have created it.
detail_page.local_tip: Go on a weekday morning for peace and soft light.

attractions.name: Gilbert Hill
attractions.summary: A giant black rock column rising in the middle of Andheri.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Gilbert Hill, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A rare natural basalt column formed from volcanic lava, standing near Andheri West. Steps lead to a small temple at the top.
detail_page.local_tip: Keep your visit short and respectful; it is a local worship spot.

attractions.name: Mahim Fort
attractions.summary: A colonial-era fort ruin at the Mahim sea edge.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Mahim Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: An old coastal fort at Mahim, long known to local residents. Its walls look over the bay and the nearby fishing community.
detail_page.local_tip: Go in daylight and keep to the open, safe areas.

attractions.name: Bandra Fort (Castella de Aguada)
attractions.summary: A Portuguese sea fort with a view of the Bandra-Worli Sea Link.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Bandra Fort (Castella de Aguada), showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A small hill-top fort at Land's End, Bandra, built by the Portuguese in the 17th century. Locals come for the sunset and the sea breeze.
important_facts: Built by the Portuguese in the 17th century
detail_page.local_tip: Late afternoon gives the best light over the sea link.

attractions.name: Worli Fort
attractions.summary: A small old fort guarding Worli's seaside.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Worli Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A compact fort built in the late 17th century to watch over the sea channel. It sits near Worli's fishing village and offers wide sea views.
detail_page.local_tip: Combine it with a walk around Worli Koliwada.

attractions.name: Sewri Fort
attractions.summary: A quiet fort beside the mudflats where flamingos gather.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Sewri Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A British-era fort at Sewri overlooking the Thane creek mudflats. From its walls you can see the sea and, in season, flamingos.
detail_page.local_tip: Carry binoculars during flamingo season.

attractions.name: Sewri Flamingo Mudflats
attractions.summary: Thousands of flamingos turn the mudflats pink every winter.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Sewri Flamingo Mudflats, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Each year, flocks of flamingos arrive at Sewri's mudflats on the Thane creek. Local bird lovers know it as one of the city's best free wildlife sights.

best_time_to_visit.value: Winter months, roughly November to March (needs verification)

detail_page.local_tip: Visit in the winter months and check the tide for best views.

attractions.name: Global Vipassana Pagoda
attractions.summary: A huge golden pagoda with a calm meditation hall, away from the city rush.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Global Vipassana Pagoda, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Located at Gorai, this pagoda was inspired by Myanmar's Shwedagon Pagoda. Its large dome holds a meditation hall and is a quiet escape for those who want stillness.
important_facts: Inspired by the Shwedagon Pagoda of Myanmar
detail_page.local_tip: Keep your voice low and phones silent; it is a meditation space.

attractions.name: Mahakali Caves (Kondivita Caves)
attractions.summary: Ancient Buddhist rock-cut caves hidden in an Andheri neighbourhood.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Mahakali Caves (Kondivita Caves), showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A group of old Buddhist caves cut into a hillside in Andheri East. Many Mumbaikars drive past without knowing they are there.
detail_page.local_tip: Wear good shoes; the climb has uneven steps.

attractions.name: Jogeshwari Caves
attractions.summary: A huge rock-cut cave temple among homes and shops.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Jogeshwari Caves, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: One of the larger rock-cut cave temples near Mumbai, with carved pillars and shrines. It is a living site, still used for worship.
detail_page.local_tip: Go on a weekday morning and respect worshippers.

attractions.name: Mandapeshwar Caves
attractions.summary: Old cave temples beside a Portuguese-era church in Borivali.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Mandapeshwar Caves, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Rock-cut caves with Hindu carvings, later reused by the Portuguese as part of a church. The mix of two eras on one hill is unusual.
detail_page.local_tip: Visit in daylight, ideally outside the hot afternoon.

attractions.name: Madh Fort
attractions.summary: A sea fort near the Koli village of Madh, known mostly to locals.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Madh Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: An old Portuguese-era fort on the Madh coast, seen from the sea and the lanes nearby. Local fishing communities live just beside it.
detail_page.local_tip: Be respectful of residents and avoid high tide.

attractions.name: Afghan Church (Church of St John the Evangelist)
attractions.summary: A tall-spired church in Colaba built to remember soldiers.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Afghan Church (Church of St John the Evangelist), showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Built in memory of British soldiers who died in the First Afghan War, it stands in a quiet corner of Colaba. Stained glass and a high spire make it stand out.
important_facts: Completed in 1858
Built in memory of soldiers who died in the First Afghan War
detail_page.local_tip: Ask for visiting permission at the gate before entering.

attractions.name: Gorai Beach
attractions.summary: A calm, uncrowded beach reached by a short ferry.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Gorai Beach, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Across the creek from Borivali, Gorai offers a quieter beach, small village lanes and easy access to the Global Pagoda.
detail_page.local_tip: Check ferry timings both ways before you cross.

attractions.name: Worli Koliwada
attractions.summary: A working Koli fishing village beside Worli Fort.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Worli Koliwada, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: One of Mumbai's original fishing communities. Colourful boats, drying fish and old lanes show a city older than its skyline.
detail_page.local_tip: Ask before taking photographs of people or their homes.

attractions.name: Shaniwar Wada
attractions.summary: The Peshwa palace-fortress at the heart of old Pune.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Shaniwar Wada, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A huge fortified palace of the Peshwas with massive gates and open courtyards. Today it stands mostly as ruins, but the big gates and walls still show its power.
important_facts: Built in 1732 under Peshwa Bajirao I
A major fire in 1828 destroyed much of the palace
detail_page.local_tip: Visit in the evening for the light, or the sound-and-light show if running.

attractions.name: Aga Khan Palace
attractions.summary: A graceful palace tied to Gandhi's years of detention.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Aga Khan Palace, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Built in 1892 by Sultan Muhammed Shah Aga Khan III, the palace is known as a place where Mahatma Gandhi, Kasturba Gandhi and others were held in the 1940s. It now holds a memorial and small museum.
important_facts: Built in 1892
Kasturba Gandhi and Mahadev Desai died here during detention
detail_page.local_tip: Spend time in the gardens and the memorial rooms; it is quiet and moving.

attractions.name: Shrimant Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati Temple
attractions.summary: Pune's best-known Ganesha temple, loved by locals.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Shrimant Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati Temple, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A famous Ganesha temple in central Pune, bright with flowers and lights, especially during Ganesh Chaturthi.
detail_page.local_tip: Visit early morning for shorter queues.

attractions.name: Sinhagad Fort
attractions.summary: A hill fort with big views and a famous battle story.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Sinhagad Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Also known as Kondhana, this hill fort rises above Pune. It is known for the 1670 battle in which Tanaji Malusare died while capturing it for Shivaji Maharaj.
important_facts: Also called Kondhana
Linked to Tanaji Malusare and the 1670 battle
detail_page.local_tip: Go early on a weekend morning; the road and fort get busy later.

attractions.name: Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum
attractions.summary: A wonderfully quirky private collection of everyday Indian objects.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A museum of lamps, musical instruments, utensils, carved doors and much more, collected by Dr. Dinkar Gangadhar Kelkar and named after his late son Raja.
detail_page.local_tip: Allow time; the collection is large and detailed.

attractions.name: Pataleshwar Cave Temple
attractions.summary: A rock-cut Shiva temple tucked among city streets.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Pataleshwar Cave Temple, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: An 8th-century monolithic cave temple in Shivajinagar, carved from a single rock. It sits in the middle of a busy city, but inside it is calm.
important_facts: Carved from a single rock in the 8th century
detail_page.local_tip: Go on a weekday morning for quiet.

attractions.name: Vetal Tekdi
attractions.summary: A forested hill used by locals for morning walks.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Vetal Tekdi, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A green hill right inside Pune, loved by walkers and runners. Short trails lead to viewpoints over the city.
detail_page.local_tip: Go at sunrise; bring water.

attractions.name: Bhaja Caves
attractions.summary: Old Buddhist caves above a quiet village near Lonavala.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Bhaja Caves, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A group of Buddhist rock-cut caves dating to around the 2nd century BCE, with a short climb through green hills.
important_facts: Dates to roughly the 2nd century BCE
detail_page.local_tip: Best after the monsoon when waterfalls and greenery are at their peak.

attractions.name: Karla Caves
attractions.summary: A grand Buddhist prayer hall carved into a hillside.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Karla Caves, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Known for a large, well-preserved chaitya hall with tall pillars. Visitors climb steps past a local temple to reach the caves.
detail_page.local_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the climb.

attractions.name: Bedse Caves
attractions.summary: Lesser-known Buddhist caves with a sweeping view of the Pavana valley.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Bedse Caves, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Ancient caves cut into a hillside near Kamshet, often visited by trekkers rather than tour groups.
detail_page.local_tip: Carry water and avoid the midday sun.

attractions.name: Lohagad Fort
attractions.summary: An easy monsoon trek to a fort with a scorpion-tail wall.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Lohagad Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A hill fort near Lonavala known for its Vinchu Kata, a long narrow spur shaped like a scorpion's tail. The climb is short and well loved by beginners.
detail_page.local_tip: Go on a weekday in monsoon to avoid crowds.

attractions.name: Visapur Fort
attractions.summary: A bigger, quieter fort next to Lohagad.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Visapur Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A sprawling hill fort near Lohagad with a large plateau and ruined structures. Many trekkers combine the two forts.
detail_page.local_tip: Start early; the climb is steeper than it looks.

attractions.name: Rajmachi Fort
attractions.summary: A twin-fort trek through forest and village trails.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Rajmachi Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A trek route with two fort peaks, Shrivardhan and Manoranjan, near Lonavala. It is often done as an overnight trek in the cooler months.
detail_page.local_tip: Carry torches and water if you plan to stay overnight.

attractions.name: Purandar Fort
attractions.summary: A hill fort tied to the birth of Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Purandar Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A strong hill fort south-east of Pune, known for the Treaty of Purandar signed in 1665 and as the birthplace of Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj.
important_facts: The Treaty of Purandar was signed in 1665
detail_page.local_tip: Check entry rules; parts may be under military control.

attractions.name: Torna Fort
attractions.summary: The first fort Shivaji Maharaj captured, now a favourite trek.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Torna Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A high, windy fort in the Velhe region, also called Prachandagad. It is known as the first fort taken by Shivaji Maharaj as a teenager.
important_facts: Also called Prachandagad
detail_page.local_tip: Start before dawn; the climb is long.

attractions.name: Rajgad Fort
attractions.summary: The long-time capital of Shivaji Maharaj before Raigad.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Rajgad Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A vast fort with three machis (terraces) and a high Balekilla, used as a capital by Shivaji Maharaj for many years before Raigad.
detail_page.local_tip: Plan a full day; the fort is huge.

attractions.name: Tamhini Ghat
attractions.summary: A misty mountain road with waterfalls in monsoon.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Tamhini Ghat, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A scenic ghat section near Mulshi, known to locals for rain-soaked drives, waterfalls and green slopes.
detail_page.local_tip: Drive carefully and avoid weekends in peak monsoon.

attractions.name: Mulshi Lake
attractions.summary: A calm reservoir ringed by hills, loved for quiet weekends.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Mulshi Lake, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A lake formed by the Mulshi dam on the Mula river. Villages and hill roads around it make a relaxed day trip.
detail_page.local_tip: Visit on a weekday for peace.

attractions.name: Pawna Lake
attractions.summary: A lakeside spot popular for camping near Lonavala.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Pawna Lake, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A large lake near Lonavala with views of Tung and Tikona forts, popular for camping and sunsets.
detail_page.local_tip: Book camps early on weekends.

attractions.name: Bhuleshwar Temple, Yawat
attractions.summary: A stone Shiva temple that looks like a small fort.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Bhuleshwar Temple, Yawat, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A Yadava-era temple at Yawat with carved stone and a fortified look, set against a hill. Few visitors know about it.
detail_page.local_tip: Check the temple's current visiting rules before you go.

attractions.name: Trimbakeshwar Temple
attractions.summary: A sacred Jyotirlinga temple near the origin of the Godavari.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Trimbakeshwar Temple, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: One of the twelve Jyotirlingas, set at the foot of Brahmagiri hill, near the source of the Godavari river.
important_facts: One of the twelve Jyotirlingas
detail_page.local_tip: Arrive early; queues grow through the morning.

attractions.name: Ramkund and Panchavati
attractions.summary: The sacred riverfront heart of Nashik.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Ramkund and Panchavati, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Ramkund is a bathing tank on the Godavari where pilgrims gather. The surrounding Panchavati area has old temples and is linked to episodes of the Ramayana.
important_facts: Nashik hosts the Kumbh Mela
detail_page.local_tip: Come at dawn or at evening aarti.

attractions.name: Kalaram Temple
attractions.summary: A black stone Ram temple, a landmark of Panchavati.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Kalaram Temple, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: An 18th-century temple in Panchavati, known for its dark stone idol and carved stone walls.
detail_page.local_tip: Try to avoid peak festival days if you prefer a quiet visit.

attractions.name: Sula Vineyards
attractions.summary: Nashik's best-known winery and vineyard setting.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Sula Vineyards, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A well-known vineyard and tasting destination that has helped Nashik become known for wine.
detail_page.local_tip: Book tastings in advance on weekends.

attractions.name: Pandavleni Caves
attractions.summary: Buddhist rock caves on a hill above the city.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Pandavleni Caves, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A group of ancient Buddhist caves, also called Trirashmi, carved into a hill south of Nashik.
detail_page.local_tip: Climb early; the steps can be tiring in heat.

attractions.name: Anjaneri Hill
attractions.summary: A trek to a hill believed to be Hanuman's birthplace.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Anjaneri Hill, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A hill near Trimbak, with a temple dedicated to Anjani Mata and wide valley views.
detail_page.local_tip: Go in the cooler months and carry water.

attractions.name: Someshwar Waterfall
attractions.summary: A popular local waterfall on the Godavari.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Someshwar Waterfall, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A pretty waterfall near Gangapur, close to Nashik. It is liveliest during and after the monsoon.
detail_page.local_tip: Be careful on wet rocks and keep away from deep water.

attractions.name: Harihar Fort
attractions.summary: A fort with a dramatic carved rock staircase.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Harihar Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A thrilling trek to a fort reached by a near-vertical rock-cut staircase.
detail_page.local_tip: Not for those afraid of heights; go with an experienced guide.

attractions.name: Gangapur Dam
attractions.summary: A calm lake spot loved by Nashik locals.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Gangapur Dam, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A dam on the Godavari with a reservoir and green banks, good for an easy evening outing.
detail_page.local_tip: Visit at sunset for the best light.

attractions.name: Ajanta Caves
attractions.summary: Buddhist rock-cut caves with ancient wall paintings.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Ajanta Caves, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A series of Buddhist caves cut into a horseshoe-shaped gorge, known for beautiful murals and sculptures.
important_facts: Declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1983
Rediscovered by a British officer in 1819
detail_page.local_tip: Carry a torch for dark corners and bring water.

attractions.name: Ellora Caves
attractions.summary: Buddhist, Hindu and Jain caves, including the huge Kailasa temple.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Ellora Caves, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A cave complex with Buddhist, Hindu and Jain monuments. Cave 16, the Kailasa temple, is carved from one rock.
important_facts: Declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1983
Cave 16 is the monolithic Kailasa temple
detail_page.local_tip: Start at the Kailasa temple before the crowds.

attractions.name: Bibi Ka Maqbara
attractions.summary: A white-domed tomb often called the Taj of the Deccan.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Bibi Ka Maqbara, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Built in the 17th century in memory of Dilras Banu Begum, wife of Aurangzeb, by her son Prince Azam Shah.
important_facts: Often called the 'Taj of the Deccan'
detail_page.local_tip: Visit near sunset for softer light.

attractions.name: Daulatabad Fort
attractions.summary: A hilltop fort with a dark, winding underground passage.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Daulatabad Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Once called Devagiri, this fort was briefly made capital by Muhammad bin Tughlaq in the 14th century.
important_facts: Muhammad bin Tughlaq shifted his capital here in 1327
detail_page.local_tip: Carry a torch and wear sturdy shoes.

attractions.name: Panchakki
attractions.summary: A 17th-century water-powered flour mill with a dargah.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Panchakki, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A historic water mill linked to the dargah of Baba Shah Musafir, known for its clever water channels.
detail_page.local_tip: Combine it with a visit to Bibi Ka Maqbara.

attractions.name: Pitalkhora Caves
attractions.summary: Some of India's earliest Buddhist rock-cut caves.

detail_page.overview: A quiet cave group near Kannad, much older than Ajanta and rarely visited.
detail_page.local_tip: Check road and access conditions before you go.

attractions.name: Khuldabad
attractions.summary: A quiet town with the simple tomb of Aurangzeb.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Khuldabad, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A small walled town near Ellora, with dargahs and the plain tomb of Emperor Aurangzeb.
detail_page.local_tip: Dress modestly and cover your head at dargahs.

attractions.name: Himayat Bagh
attractions.summary: A mango-orchard garden used by locals for walks.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Himayat Bagh, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A leafy garden-orchard in the city, with old trees and calm paths.
detail_page.local_tip: Go at morning or evening for cooler air.

attractions.name: Soneri Mahal
attractions.summary: A small old palace with painted rooms.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Soneri Mahal, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A historic palace building now used as a small museum, with decorated walls and peaceful courtyards.
detail_page.local_tip: Check current visiting hours before travelling.

attractions.name: Mhaismal
attractions.summary: A small hill station on the Deccan plateau.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Mhaismal, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A cool-weather hill spot known for sunsets, viewpoints and a calm, rural pace.
detail_page.local_tip: Visit in the monsoon or winter for the best weather.

attractions.name: Deekshabhoomi
attractions.summary: The great white stupa where Dr. Ambedkar embraced Buddhism.

important_facts: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar embraced Buddhism here in 1956
detail_page.local_tip: Visit around Dhamma Chakra Pravartan Din for a big gathering.

attractions.name: Zero Mile Stone
attractions.summary: A marker for the geographic centre of India.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Zero Mile Stone, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: Set up in 1907 during the Great Trigonometrical Survey as a reference point. A small monument stands at the spot.
important_facts: Set up in 1907
detail_page.local_tip: A short stop; combine with other city sights.

attractions.name: Sitabuldi Fort
attractions.summary: A small hill fort tied to the 1817 battle.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Sitabuldi Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A fort on a hill in central Nagpur, known for the Battle of Sitabuldi in 1817.
important_facts: Battle of Sitabuldi fought in 1817
detail_page.local_tip: Check access rules, as parts may be restricted.

attractions.name: Ramtek Fort
attractions.summary: A hill-top temple complex linked to the Ramayana.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Ramtek Fort, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A temple complex on a hill near Nagpur, linked to Lord Ram in local tradition, with wide views.
detail_page.local_tip: Climb early and carry water.

attractions.name: Futala Lake
attractions.summary: Nagpur's favourite lakeside evening spot.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Futala Lake, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A city lake with a food street and sunset crowd, known to every local.
detail_page.local_tip: Come for the evening snacks.

attractions.name: Seminary Hills
attractions.summary: A green hill for morning walks and city views.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Seminary Hills, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A hill with forest cover and viewpoints, loved by walkers.
detail_page.local_tip: Go in the morning for cooler air.

attractions.name: Dragon Palace Temple, Kamptee

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Dragon Palace Temple, Kamptee, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A well-kept Buddhist temple at Kamptee, built with Japanese support, known for its calm gardens.
detail_page.local_tip: Keep your voice low and respect shoes-off rules.

attractions.name: Ambazari Lake
attractions.summary: A calm lake with a garden, popular with families.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Ambazari Lake, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: One of Nagpur's old lakes, with a garden alongside and sunset walks.
detail_page.local_tip: Evenings are lively; mornings are peaceful.

important_facts: Regarded as a Shakti Peetha
detail_page.local_tip: Avoid festival days if you want a quieter visit.

attractions.name: New Palace Kolhapur

important_facts: Built between 1877 and 1884
Designed by Major Charles Mant
detail_page.local_tip: Allow time for the museum rooms.

attractions.name: Rankala Lake
attractions.summary: A beloved lake where Kolhapur gathers in the evening.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Rankala Lake, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A city lake with a walkway and snack stalls, known for sunset gatherings.
detail_page.local_tip: Try local snacks from the stalls.

attractions.name: Panhala Fort

detail_page.overview: A large fort on a hill above Kolhapur, with old walls, gates and wide views.
detail_page.local_tip: Go early and wear good shoes.

attractions.name: Pavankhind
attractions.summary: A mountain pass remembered for Baji Prabhu Deshpande's stand.

image.brief: Original or licensed wide daytime photo of Pavankhind, showing its most recognisable view

detail_page.overview: A historic pass near Vishalgad, linked to Baji Prabhu Deshpande's last stand in 1660.
important_facts: Linked to the stand of Baji Prabhu Deshpande in 1660
detail_page.local_tip: Read the memorial information to understand the story.

attractions.name: Bhudargad Fort
attractions.summary: A large hill fort tucked into the Sahyadri foothills.

detail_page.overview: A big hill fort with old walls and a quiet setting, away from tour routes.
detail_page.local_tip: Wear sturdy shoes and carry water.

attractions.name: Kopeshwar Temple, Khidrapur

detail_page.local_tip: Ask locals for the best spots to see the carvings.

attractions.name: Raigad Fort

detail_page.local_tip: A ropeway exists; check its current operation.

detail_page.overview: The temple complex of Sai Baba in Shirdi draws devotees of many faiths across the year.
